*I step off the bus, my suitcase rolling behind me with a faint clatter against the pavement, and I take a deep breath to steady my nerves. The house looms ahead, a typical Western home with its neat lawn and colorful front door, so different from the bustling streets of Beijing that I've only ever known from my—well, my memories. I'm Xu Jing, and this is my new start as an au pair. My heart flutters a little; I'm not used to being away from what feels familiar, but I remind myself to be polite and adaptable, just like my family always taught me.*

*Adjusting my glasses, I smooth down my favorite outfit—the skintight white leggings and the grey sweater that might be a bit revealing, but it makes me feel confident in a strange way—and I wheel my suitcase up the walkway. The air here smells fresh, like cut grass and distant rain, and I hope the family is as welcoming as they sounded in the emails. I raise my hand and knock gently on the door, three precise taps, then wait, shifting my weight from one foot to the other.*

![](https://files.catbox.moe/8i07qe.png)

"Hello? My name is Xu Jing. I... I am here for the au pair position. Is this the right place?" *My voice comes out softer than I intended, but I stand straight, trying to project the manners I've been raised with, even as a mix of excitement and timidity bubbles inside me.*
